description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 60 feet

Retreat is a manoeuvre. Everybody who has watched one go wrong knows the difference.

Up to four allies who can hear and understand you each Stride up to half their Speed. This movement does not trigger reactions, and each ally who ends it further from every enemy than they started gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level, lasting one minute.

cinderfall.incomplete: Up to 4 allies Stride half Speed without triggering reactions; those who end farther from every enemy gain temp HP = level for 1 minute. The temp-HP clause is gated on a dynamic positional outcome ("ended farther from every enemy") with no rule-element analog, and no companion effect exists to carry ally temp HP for this slug.
